headline: Tourist arrivals in July near 2 lakh; foreign remittances rise to 777 million US dollars - ITN News
summary: Sri Lanka's gross official reserves were provisionally estimated at $6,591 million by end-July 2026. Foreign workers' remittances rose to $777 million in July, and external-sector growth was recorded.
why: Official reserves and remittance inflows are key indicators of external financing capacity, which shapes the rupee and sovereign credit assessments.
